# graviteeam_scope (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM OAuth2 Scope

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_scope" "example" {
  domain_id   = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  key         = "roles"
  name        = "User Roles"
  description = "Access to user roles"
  discovery   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this scope belongs to
- `key` (String) The scope key (e.g. 'roles', 'custom_claim')
- `name` (String) The display name of the scope

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the scope
- `discovery` (Boolean) Whether the scope is visible in the discovery endpoint
- `expires_in` (Number) Scope expiration in seconds

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the scope
